title: ObjectShell
description: The portfolio-wide canonical object shell — the JSON-Schema contract for templates/schema-objects/canonical_object_shell.json. Every major object (ContextArtifact, SkillArtifact, ToolArtifact, HarnessArtifact, TemplateArtifact, PurposeTask runs, receipts) composes from this ONE outer shape so no product invents incompatible id/status/provenance/tenant/visibility/resource fields. Runtime branches on numeric codes (visibility_code/status_code), never display labels. security holds secret_refs only — NEVER a raw secret. Built by src/teleon/templates/instantiator.compose_object_shell.

payload_ref.description: ArtifactRef/PayloadRef for large payloads — do not inline big bodies

model_preference_ref.description: optional REF to an InferencePreference (preference_id) — how an object declares its model preference for the shared LLM plane. BY REFERENCE only: never an inline raw preference, provider key, or secret. The Inference Gateway resolves it (inheritance) and records the actual model used in a ModelInvocationReceipt.
